name: Aayat Arts
tagline: Nature Rendered in Acrylic and Watercolor — Original Paintings by Aayat Arts
intro: I paint the quiet details of the natural world — misted valleys, watchful wildlife, and the delicate structure of a single bloom — in photorealistic acrylic and watercolor. Each piece begins with hours spent observing light before a single brushstroke is made.
bio: I paint to slow down and pay attention — to the way light moves across a hillside, the alertness in a wild animal's eyes, the structure hidden inside a single petal.

My journey into painting began over fifteen years ago, sketching birds in the garden of my childhood home. What started as a way to notice the world more closely grew into a full-time practice in acrylic and watercolor, focused entirely on the landscapes, animals and plants I encounter on long walks near my studio.

Each painting can take anywhere from two weeks to several months, built up in thin layers to capture the realism I look for — the texture of fur, the translucence of a leaf held up to the sun, the haze of distance in a valley. My goal is always the same: to make you feel like you could step into the scene.
Today my work is held in private collections mostly North America and Europe, and I continue to paint from my studio, taking on select commissions each year.
